# Images the platform charts render that are deliberately NOT Docker Hardened.
#
# The mirror drift check in .github/workflows/ci.yml fails if a chart renders an
# image that is neither on our DHI mirror nor listed here. That is the check that
# was MISSING when the loki 6.7.1 -> 7.3.0 bump silently introduced
# `docker.io/kiwigrid/k8s-sidecar:2.5.0`: the old check only verified that dhi/*
# refs were mirrored, so a brand-new non-DHI image was invisible to it.
#
# Adding a line here is a deliberate decision, not a formality — say WHY, so the
# next person can tell "no DHI equivalent exists" apart from "nobody looked yet".
#
# Format: one image reference (registry/repo:tag), exactly as rendered.
# Tracking: Blue-Dots-Economy/bluedots-automation#136

# ── Kong ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DHI publishes the Kong GATEWAY but no kubernetes-ingress-controller. Swapping
# only the gateway while the controller beside it stays upstream buys little and
# splits the pair across two provenance chains, so both stay upstream until the
# controller has an equivalent.
kong:3.9
kong/kubernetes-ingress-controller:3.5

# ── Redis ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# NOT blocked — DHI does publish Redis. This is simply unassessed: the chart is
# Bitnami's, which wires its own entrypoint, user and TLS handling around the
# image, so a swap needs verifying rather than assuming. Candidate for the next
# pass.
docker.io/bitnamilegacy/redis:7.2.5
